content:
CONFIRMED — Opening an existing `host.db` with populated `ji_host_sessions.document` rows but no preexisting `ji_host_timeline` creates an empty projection table without migration or backfill. `timeline()` reads that table directly and therefore returns an empty historical timeline until the session is subsequently saved. An ordinary later save does backfill the wholly empty projection through `replaceTimelineProjection`.

Exact current line: `E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\ji-java\adapters\ji-host-sqlite\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\host\sqlite\SqliteHostStorePersistence.java:77`
